name: 993 oval exhaust tip, IN625 double-wall F0 concept
description: Independent round-to-oval concept with a ventilated double wall and eight integrated attachments to screen LPBF manufacture in IN625. FVD publishes only a 120 x 85 mm outlet envelope for its FVD11199300 stainless tip; PorscheFanatics separately documents an IN625 precedent on 993 Turbo exhausts.

classification.intended_use: CAD, DfAM, flow, thermal, pressure and modal screening; no manufacturing for fitting and no vehicle installation authorized

provenance.record_license: MIT for the concept, the script and the calculations; no photograph, trademark, PET illustration or commercial geometry redistributed

sources.title: FVD - 993 narrow-body oval stainless tips
sources.notes: FVD declares 120 mm at the widest, 85 mm at the tallest, stainless construction and C2/C4/RS applications. No inlet diameter, length, angle, thickness or datum. See SRC-FVD-993-EXHAUST-TIPS-DIMENSIONS.

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - register of declared materials
sources.notes: Documents 993 Turbo exhaust offerings declared in IN625; material precedent only, with no geometry and no fitment transfer. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-IN625-EXHAUST-REGISTER.

sources.title: EOS NickelAlloy IN625 material data sheet
sources.notes: M 290 40 µm screening values, dependent on orientation and post-processing. See SRC-EOS-IN625-MATERIAL-DATA.

sources.title: Special Metals - INCONEL alloy 625
sources.notes: Reference wrought thermal properties, never an LPBF allowables card. See SRC-SPECIAL-METALS-INCONEL-625.

material.grade: EOS NickelAlloy IN625 / UNS N06625 for screening; FVD product declared stainless
material.standard: ASTM F3055, AMS 7000 or AMS 7001 to be contracted if the LPBF route is selected

post_processing: complete powder removal through both ends of the double wall
stress relief qualified for the machine and parameters
build plate cut-off with ovality control
machining of the slip fit and clamping seat after adding machining stock
deburring and polishing of the gas path
passivation or surface finish to be defined after testing
supplier_requirements: traceable powder, machine, parameters, orientation, lot and recycling
demonstrated capability on 0.8 mm double walls and a 2.7 mm open air gap
support strategy and distortion simulation before launch
dimensional inspection of the connection, oval, angle and clearances
CT or radiography of the double wall and dye penetrant inspection after finishing
leak, vibration, thermal cycling and rear valance temperature tests before vehicle use

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Galvanic compatibility of IN625 with clamp, tube and fasteners to be defined after the actual materials are identified.

known_limits: Only the 120 x 85 mm outlet comes from FVD; length, inlet, double walls and attachments are hypothetical.
The STEP volume gives 406.38 g in IN625; no comparable commercial mass is published.
The Borda-Carnot loss screening is a sudden-expansion bound, not a prediction for the gradual diffuser.
The 44.12 Hz strip mode is not a shell mode and cannot be compared with an absent vehicle spectrum.
Temperatures, flow rates, pressures, volumetric efficiency and support conditions are synthetic.
The calculation ignores pulses, upstream bends, joints, convection, CHT, ovalization, roughness, oxidation and thermal fatigue.
The steady RANS CFD reaches its residual thresholds but the pressure loss still varies by 11.17% between the two finest meshes and the extended checks keep low-determinant cells.
The full-part slicing and the EOS M 290 scene contain no supplier supports, no laser paths, and no correlated thermomechanical or recoater simulation.
The SimReady profile passes only for an isolated prop; the physical properties invented by the agents were removed and no exhaust-valance assembly is available.
PhysicsNeMo has only run a CUDA smoke test; no surrogate model is trained before the physical cases converge and are correlated.
The STEP proves only a computable BREP within the envelope and must not be manufactured for fitting.
